mismatch.message: unsupported hero move: a trap the hero has already seen

summary: The saved replay stops on the second #sit because JavaScript preflight rejects a seen MAGIC_TRAP before dotrap runs. C permits the seen-trap escape roll; this recording rolls 3 on rn2(5), continues into trapeffect_magic_trap, and triggers the explosion.

source.branch: For an already-seen trap, dotrap performs the escape roll only when the hero is not fumbling, the trap is destroyable, the trap is not ANTI_MAGIC, no force-bungle/plunge/conjoined-pit/adjacent-pit condition applies, and the call is not forced. MAGIC_TRAP satisfies those conditions. If rn2(5) is nonzero, dotrap proceeds to trapeffect_selector and the magic-trap effect.
callers: sit.c:dosit (400-568) calls dotrap(trap, VIASITTING) when a trap is under the hero and the hero is not already trapped; js/sit.js:dosit already dispatches this call from cmd.js #sit.

evidence: Saved queue SHA-256 8159324bc02a3fa2724e8603cae7a6809fbbbaff1883c62684a0478b91a06f03 records v39-magic-trap-explosion with 1 remaining screen, 25 recorded steps, and a stop at segment 0 step 24: unsupported hero move: a trap the hero has already seen. Its admitted recipe creates a magic trap with wizard debug input, then runs #sit twice.

The C caller path is sit.c:dosit at lines 400-568: when a trap is under the hero and the hero is not already trapped, it prints the landing/sitting message and calls dotrap(trap, VIASITTING). The JavaScript caller already does the same at js/sit.js:898-902.

Upstream trap.c:dotrap lines 3035-3043 does not blanket-refuse seen traps. MAGIC_TRAP is not undestroyable and is not ANTI_MAGIC, so C rolls rn2(5); the saved second #sit records rn2(5)=3 at dotrap(trap.c:3038), proceeds to trapeffect_selector, then records rn2(30)=0 and rnd(10)=5 in trapeffect_magic_trap(trap.c:2300-2304).

js/trap_effects.js:preflight_dotrap rejects a seen trap at lines 3918-3927 because MAGIC_TRAP is absent from its allowlist. That guard runs before the already-ported dotrap seen-trap roll and trapeffect_magic_trap branch, producing the saved unsupported-move stop. scripts/hero-magic-trap.test.mjs:134-142 currently pins this incorrect refusal.

The narrowly actionable fix is to admit already-seen MAGIC_TRAP through preflight while preserving all other unsupported seen-trap refusals. The existing dotrap implementation then performs C-order rn2(5) and reaches the existing magic-trap effect. No sit caller change or new recipe is needed; the admitted v39 range covers segment 0 step 24.

Fresh C/JavaScript differential `node scripts/diff-fresh.mjs challenges/cases/v39/v39-magic-trap-explosion.recipe.session.json` reproduced the same refusal at segment 1 step 25 (bounded run-4DTJbH, .cache/B214-investigation-fresh-diff.log): C records rn2(5)=3 at dotrap(trap.c:3038), then has the screen and cursor boundary that JavaScript omits after the seen-MAGIC_TRAP preflight error.
